_doc: Director decision backend. claude = a small Claude model via claude -p. decisions = a decisions model (decisions_model) behind the Vercel AI Gateway, key in Keychain under service <slug>-ai-gateway: yes/no questions combined in code; anything under decisions_min_confidence goes to claude. shadow logs the decisions model's route next to claude's in log/routes.jsonl without acting on it. Compare in Performance before switching.
